Issue: Mixed date formats; day/month ambiguous where both <= 12
Count: 485 dates cast; 7 rows (7 values) resolved by decision
Decision: Cast to YYYY-MM-DD; ambiguous values resolved as listed in the config
Rationale: The dates range from March to June: 01-04-2026 (TXN10011) is April 1st; 04/12/2026 and 04/01/2026 are April; 05/07/2026 is May; 12-03-2026 is March; 05/05/2026 can go either way, so it doesn't matter. That leaves one record, 06-04-2026, which is June 4th, 2026.
